Post-hoc shared-vs-specific assessment of fitted programs (mashr)

program_sharing.Rd

Assesses which fitted programs are the SAME biological program across cell types (shared gene loadings) versus cell-type-private, using mashr-style adaptive shrinkage: for each matched program group (one program per cell type) the G x C matrix of canonicalized loadings and their posterior SDs go to [mashr::mash()] with the canonical plus data-driven (PCA/ED) covariance set and the CorShrink-style null-correlation matrix [`.estimate_V`]. The estimated mixture weights over covariance patterns ARE the empirical sharing patterns (e.g. `equal_effects` = shared across all conditions, `singletons_*` = one cell type only).

Usage

program_sharing(
  fit,
  matches = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_top = 50L,
  lfsr_thresh = 0.05,
  n_perm = 199L,
  seed = 1L,
  min_genes = 50L,
  min_null = 20L,
  z_thresh = 1,
  data_driven = TRUE,
  npc = 3L,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

fit

A canonicalized `cell_program_fit` with stored loading posterior SDs (fits from older versions must be refit).

matches

`NULL` (default): run [`.match_programs_loadings`] and group matches significant at FDR `alpha`. Alternatively a pairwise match table (columns ct_a/prog_a/ct_b/prog_b, optionally q), one matched set, or a list of matched sets (data.frames with columns cell_type, program_id).

alpha

FDR level for candidate matches and the strong-gene subset for data-driven covariances (default 0.05).

n_top

Number of top-|loading| genes per group for the summary fractions (default 50).

lfsr_thresh

lfsr threshold calling a gene active in a condition (default 0.05).

n_perm, seed

Permutation calibration for the matching step.

min_genes

Minimum shared-panel size per group (default 50).

min_null

Minimum null genes for V estimation (else identity).

z_thresh

|z| below this in every condition marks a null gene for V estimation (default 1). With many conditions the intersection at 1 can be empty; raise to ~1.5 for large matched groups.

data_driven

Add PCA/ED data-driven covariances to the canonical set (default TRUE; skipped with a warning when too few strong genes).

npc

Number of PCA covariance components (capped at #conditions).

verbose

Let mashr print progress (default FALSE).

...

Passed to [mashr::mash()].

Value

An object of class `program_sharing`: * `matches`: the pairwise candidate-match table (NULL for explicit groups); * `groups`: list of matched-set data.frames (cell_type, program_id); * `results`: per-group list with `B_hat`/`S_hat` (mash inputs), `V`, `posterior_mean` and `lfsr` (G x C), `mixture_weights` (mashr's pi over the scaled covariance grid), `pattern_weights` (pi aggregated over base covariance patterns), `p_all_shared` (mean posterior weight of the equal_effects pattern over the top genes), `frac_top_shared` / `frac_top_private` (fraction of the top `n_top` genes with lfsr < `lfsr_thresh` in >= 2 / exactly 1 conditions), `classification` ("shared" if frac_top_shared >= 0.5, "private" if frac_top_private >= 0.5, else "partial"), and the full `mash` result; * `summary`: one row per program. Programs in no matched group are classified "private" with evidence "no_significant_match".

Details

This concerns shared GENE LOADINGS only. Coordinated DONOR ACTIVITY (CMP detection, [find_coordinated_programs()]) is a separate axis and a separate workstream; a shared program need not have correlated donor scores.

Examples

sim <- simulate_pseudobulk(n_samples = 20, n_genes = 150, program_size = 20, seed = 1)
x <- as_cell_program_data(sim$pseudobulk)
fit <- fit_celltype_programs(x, max_factors = 3, features = "variable", n_variable_genes = 100)
fit <- canonicalize_programs(fit)
# Assess one matched set explicitly (skips the permutation matching step);
# with matches = NULL, candidate matches are data-driven.
if (requireNamespace("mashr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  grp <- data.frame(cell_type = c("CD8", "NK"), program_id = c("CD8_1", "NK_1"))
  res <- program_sharing(fit, matches = grp, n_top = 20)
  res$summary
}
